# hostd_security_group_rule (Resource)

One rule of a firewall security group, evaluated by `position` from 0. The API addresses a rule only by that position, so rules of one group must be applied in position order (`depends_on`); a parallel apply can shift them. Changing `project_id` or `security_group_id` replaces the rule. Import with `<project_id>,<security_group_id>,<position>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hostd_security_group_rule" "ssh" {
  project_id         = hostd_security_group.web.project_id
  security_group_id  = hostd_security_group.web.id
  position           = 0
  type               = "in"
  action             = "ACCEPT"
  proto              = "tcp"
  source             = "+${hostd_ip_set.office.pve_ipset_name}"
  dport              = "22"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `ACCEPT` or `DROP`.
- `position` (Number) Zero-based position. Changing it moves the rule.
- `project_id` (String) UUID of the project the security group belongs to.
- `proto` (String) `tcp`, `udp` or `icmp`. Ports are only valid for `tcp` and `udp`.
- `security_group_id` (String) UUID of the security group (`hostd_security_group`).
- `type` (String) Direction: `in` or `out`.

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Free-text comment. Empty by default.
- `dest` (String) Destination address, CIDR, IPv4 range, or an IP set as `+<pve_ipset_name>`. Same limits as `source`.
- `dport` (String) Destination port, range (`80:85`) or list. TCP and UDP only.
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the rule is enabled. Defaults to true.
- `source` (String) Source address, CIDR (IPv4 no larger than `/26`, IPv6 no larger than `/64`), IPv4 range, or an IP set as `+<pve_ipset_name>`.
- `sport` (String) Source port, range (`80:85`) or list. TCP and UDP only.
